C0298.title: Runtime Detection of CPU-Exhaustion DoS Attacks
C0298.summary: This research proposes a detection mechanism for application-layer CPU-exhaustion denial-of-service attacks. Unlike traditional high-volume attacks, these attacks exploit algorithmic or implementation vulnerabilities to consume significant server CPU resources with a small number of carefully crafted requests, and they lack identifiable patterns.
